settings.heading: Build Time: 30–40 Hours
settings.content:
Touring frames need strong, reliable joints for loaded riding.

Prep: 2–3 hrs · Jig & tubes: 5–7 hrs · Bonding: 12–16 hrs · Curing: 24–48 hrs · Finishing: 8–10 hrs

settings.heading: Durability & Strength
settings.content:
Lifespan: 8–12 years with proper care

Tensile strength: ~28,000 PSI — comparable to mild steel

Failure rate: Under 1% across 4,000+ builds

Bamboo naturally absorbs road vibration better than metal, giving you a smoother, more comfortable ride. Tested with Swansea University.

settings.heading: Your Build Journey
settings.subtitle: Most builders spread this over a few weekends

settings.heading: Do I need special tools?
settings.row_content: No power tools required. Basic hand tools: hacksaw, files, sandpaper, measuring tape, and a work surface. Everything else is in the kit.

settings.heading: What if I make a mistake?
settings.row_content: Most mistakes are fixable. Epoxy can be sanded and re-applied. Bamboo is forgiving. If you're stuck, our community has seen every problem — someone will have the answer within hours.

settings.heading: What else do I need to complete the bike?
settings.row_content: Fork, wheels, groupset, handlebars, saddle, and finishing components. We offer component packs with everything included, or source parts from any bike shop.

settings.heading: How strong is a bamboo frame?
settings.row_content: ~28,000 PSI tensile strength — comparable to mild steel, but lighter. Under 1% failure rate across 4,000+ builds since 2012. Tested with Swansea University.

settings.heading: Can I ride in the rain?
settings.row_content: Yes. Finished frames are sealed with epoxy resin. Dry your bike after wet rides and store indoors.

settings.heading: How long will the frame last?
settings.row_content: 8–12 years with proper care. Many of our 2012 builds are still being ridden daily.

settings.heading: Can it carry panniers and touring loads?
settings.row_content: Designed for it. Rack and mudguard mounts included. Bamboo's vibration damping is a genuine advantage on loaded long-distance rides.
